page: OVHcloud r3-128 is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor running at 2.3 GHz, providing 16 dedicated physical cores with no hyperthreading. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 400 GB NVMe SSD, and the network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results show a top-tier PassMark memory score in the top 10% of tested instances. Large-block memory read and write bandwidth tests place the instance in the top 25%, indicating efficient data transfer for large datasets, though small-block cached reads remain in the average range. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is strong, ranking in the top 25%, while multi-core CPU performance and overall Geekbench scores fall within the average middle 50%. Text processing and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression also show strong performance in the top 25%.

The dedicated core allocation ensures predictable CPU performance without resource sharing, though the lack of hyperthreading limits concurrent thread execution compared to hyperthreaded alternatives. The high memory density relative to CPU cores makes this instance qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require massive parallel compute. It is suitable for in-memory databases, caching layers, text processing, and medium-scale data processing tasks.
